markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, MUSK agreement and 4/5 similar cases agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, rest <1% | Strongly invasive |
| Conformal set | Invasive only (90%) | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / 1.0 | Not flagged (blur simulated) |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Models concur |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Invasive | One InSitu neighbor |

## Tissue evidence
- **Scarce normal lobules** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Low score; absence associated with invasive carcinoma [F2] · Unreliable
- **Little benign stroma/fat** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Low score; scarcity associated with invasive carcinoma [F4] · Validated
- **Frequent mitoses** (regions 0, 2, 10) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score; spot check failed · Unreliable
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score; small concept-model contribution · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0: not shown to reflect classifier. Leans on Unreliable normal-lobule and mitosis scores.

## Could be wrong if
- Blur is simulated (severity 3); reliability score ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69).
- Calibration tested on 132 cases (ECE 5%, CI 3–18%); 100% may overstate.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 9, 0**: highest heatmap contribution; confirm invasive carcinoma.
2. **Regions 0, 2, 10**: confirm mitotic figures; concept failed spot check (0/20).
3. **Region 11**: near-zero invasive risk; confirm benign tissue.
